judge.reason: The replay fixed the original quoted-reply bug and added a partial-send error and a template type, but it never implemented the voice mapping, captioned group send, richlink/app preview, __platform-tagged WhatsApp-only template, or poison-guard test, and it wrapped interactive fallback events in reply contrary to c6. It also implemented before branching/planning and did not actually verify spectrum-webhook compatibility, so multiple non-withdrawn criteria are unmet.
